production.note: US model years. Start: 2015 was the first model year; Corvette Action Center's 2015 model year production listing (Bowling Green Assembly data) shows Z06 coupe 6,980 and Z06 convertible 1,673. End: the 2019 model year price list still includes "Corvette Z06 Coupe" (1YZ07) and "Corvette Z06 Conv" (1YZ67) (source cac-2019-pricing); the 2020 model year Corvette was the mid-engine C8 (GM: "Chevrolet Introduces First-Ever Mid-Engine Corvette for 2020", source gm-2020-c8-release).

body.note: GM: "2-door hatchback coupe with removable roof panel or 2-door convertible; rear-wheel drive". Both bodies were sold from the 2015 model year (source cac-2015-production).

displacementL.note: 6,162 cc. GM Powertrain: "6162 cc (376 ci)"; GM's 2016 table: "Displacement (cu in / cc): 376 / 6162" (source gm-2016-z06-specs).

transmission.note: GM table: "Seven-speed manual with Active Rev Match" and "Paddle-shift eight-speed, electronically controlled automatic overdrive" (a torque-converter automatic). Both were offered from the 2015 model year: GM's January 2014 release names "a seven-speed manual and an all-new eight-speed automatic transmission" (source gm-2015-z06-history-release).

powerHp.note: SAE certified. Quote, GM Powertrain's 2015 Corvette Z06 LT4 engine specifications: "650 hp (485kW) @ 6400 rpm SAE Certified". GM's 2016 Z06 table repeats "Horsepower (hp / kW @ rpm): 650 / 485 @ 6400 – SAE certified" (source gm-2016-z06-specs). At the January 2014 reveal GM quoted "an estimated 625 horsepower" (see discrepancies). GM's European release for the same car prints "659 hp (485 kW)", the metric-horsepower equivalent of the same 485 kW, which is not the US rating.

weightLb.note: Manufacturer curb weight, standard Z06 coupe without the Z07 package. Quote, GM's US specification table (2016 model year): "Curb weight (lb / kg): 3524 / 1598 (coupe) 3582 / 1625 (convertible)". GM's March 2015 release for the 2015 Z06 prints the identical row, "Curb weight (lb / kg): 3524 / 1598 (coupe) 3582 / 1625 (convertible)" (source gm-2015-z06-geneva-release, issued for Europe), and GM Authority reported the same 2015 figures from GM's order guide in August 2014: "the 650 horsepower, 650 pound-foot 2015 Corvette Z06 Coupe will come in at 3,524 lbs" (source gmauthority-z06-weight-2014). GM's tables give one figure per body and do not split it by transmission.

discrepancies.reason: Estimate vs certified rating: GM's January 2014 reveal material quoted "an estimated 625 horsepower"; the SAE-certified rating published before the car went on sale is 650 hp at 6,400 rpm.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 650 hp, the SAE-certified rating in GM Powertrain's 2015 specification sheet and GM's 2016 table.
